items.title: Joseph Ralph Robinson Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: I never knew him but I knew his stepfather but I never knew Buddy.

ctx.x: Do you remember anything about Baby Dodds, the drummer, when he got his instrument? Do you remember when he started playing? Was he playing when he was working?
Yeah, he used to play with some boys they called Buddy Petey. That was the dad he was playing with.
While he was at the bag factory?
